notes: Read all 184 source lines line by line before editing. Every line is accounted for below; behaviour, the exported component's props contract + names, the recentLive/items derivations, the status/type lookups, the timeAgo + formatDurationMs + fmtPercent formatting, the five-branch render order/conditions, and every i18n key + English default are preserved. No physical units appear (counts, percentages, ms durations only), so there is no SI/display unit handling to convert.

L1-3 file JSDoc ('displays recent execution history + live SSE events'): summarised + preserved in the native file header, which additionally documents every web->native remap and native-safe fallback.
L4 useMemo: imported from react and used verbatim for recentLive.

L5 react-i18next useTranslation: not in the native parity manifest -> inlined useNativeTranslation(): a stable (key, fallback, options?) => fallback shim (useCallback []) reproducing i18next {{name}} interpolation. Used at every t('key','English') call site so i18n intent is preserved (no interpolation is used here; the options branch is retained for parity).
L6 @/lib/cn cn: dropped — RN composes styles via arrays, not className merges; every cn(...) call site becomes a StyleSheet style array.
L7 @/lib/dateFormat formatDurationMs: ported byte-for-byte (incl. the isFiniteNumber guard and the '—' FALLBACK) — '—' when non-finite, `${ms}ms` when < 1000, else `${(ms/1000).toFixed(1)}s`.

L8 @/lib/numberFormat fmtPercent: ported byte-for-byte over ported safeNumber + fmtNumber (default precision 2 / en-US, toLocaleString with min/max fraction digits + the bad-locale try/catch fallback); fmtPercent(v,0) -> `${fmtNumber(v,0)}%`.
L9 @/components/ui GlassPanel: -> the existing native GlassPanel (styles.panel adds the web p-6 = 24px padding).
L10 @/components/ui Badge: -> inline native Badge (neutral variant) — an alignSelf:flex-start rounded-full surfaceRaised/border chip with a caption label; used by LiveEventRow.
L11 @/components/feedback EmptyState: -> inline native EmptyState (SemanticIcon 'activity' + message, no title) matching the web icon+message shape.
L12 @/components/feedback Skeleton: -> inline placeholder bars (styles.skeleton: surfaceRaised, borderRadius 8 = rounded-lg, height 40 = h-10).

L13 @/components/motion FadeIn: -> inline Animated.View opacity 0->1 mount fade honouring the same delay (delay*1000 ms); reduced-motion is not observable on bare RN so the decorative entry fade always plays.

L14-16 lucide-react CheckCircle/XCircle/SkipForward/Activity/Clock/Wifi/WifiOff/Zap: -> small colour-coded text glyphs (Glyph) for the inline 16px row/header icons, the shared SemanticIcon 'activity' chip for the 32px empty-state icon, and small colour dots for the Wifi/WifiOff connection indicator. The animate-pulse on the live icon + reconnecting indicator -> an Animated opacity loop (Pulse).
L17 @/api/types AutomationHistory + AutomationHistoryStats: imported from the already-ported native ../../../api/types (identical shapes).

L18 @/hooks/useAutomationEvents AutomationActivityEvent: the hook is not ported, so its type is reproduced locally (exported) over the AutomationSSEEventType + Triggered/Succeeded/Failed/Skipped/StateChanged unions imported from ../../../api/types, so the liveEvents prop shape is byte-identical (id/type/data/receivedAt).

L20-31 statusConfig Record<string,{icon,color,label}>: -> statusConfig Record<string,{glyph,color,label}> with the same eight keys (success/partial/failed/skipped/test/undo/running/cancelled), the same labels, and the lucide icons mapped to glyphs (CheckCircle->'OK', XCircle->'X', SkipForward->'»', Zap->'ZP', Clock->'CK', Activity->'AC'). Tailwind colours are preserved verbatim as hex (green-400 #4ade80, amber-400 #fbbf24, red-400 #f87171, purple-400 #c084fc, blue-400 #60a5fa); text-[--text-muted] -> colors.textMuted; text-neon-cyan -> colors.accent. label is kept for shape parity even though (as on web) it is never rendered.
L33-41 timeAgo(iso): ported verbatim — Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime(); 'just now' (<1m), `${mins}m ago` (<60m), `${hours}h ago` (<24h), else `${days}d ago`.

L43-65 HistoryRow({item}): ported. cfg = statusConfig[item.status] ?? statusConfig.running (the ?? .running fallback preserved); the hover-row becomes styles.row (gap-3=12, rounded-lg, px-3 py-2); the lucide Icon -> <Glyph color={cfg.color} text={cfg.glyph}/>; the min-w-0 flex-1 name div -> styles.rowMain with a semibold textPrimary name (numberOfLines 1) and, when item.error, the ml-2 red-400/80 '— error' (rgba(248,113,133,0.8)); the three shrink-0 muted-caption metas render timeAgo(item.triggered_at), formatDurationMs(item.duration_ms), and — only when item.actions_total > 0 — `${item.actions_succeeded}/${item.actions_total}`.

L67-98 LiveEventRow({event}): ported. The local typeMap (5 automation.* keys) -> liveTypeConfig (Zap/CheckCircle/XCircle/SkipForward/Activity -> glyphs; neon-cyan/green-400/red-400/[--text-muted]/purple-400 colours); cfg = liveTypeConfig[event.type] ?? liveTypeConfig['automation.triggered']; the name probe ('name' in event.data ? data.name : `#${data.automation_id}`) is byte-identical; the bg-neon-cyan/[0.03] row -> styles.liveRow rgba(53,213,255,0.03); the animate-pulse icon -> <Glyph pulse/>; the 'error' in data && data.error -> red-400/80 '— error', and 'reason' in data && data.reason -> [--text-muted] '— reason' (both preserved, both shown when present); the neutral Badge renders event.type.replace('automation.','').

L100-108 interface AutomationActivityFeedProps { history, historyStats: AutomationHistoryStats | null, isLoading, liveEvents, connectionState: 'connected'|'reconnecting' }: ported verbatim (exported).

L110-121 export function AutomationActivityFeed({...}) + const { t } = useTranslation() + recentLive = useMemo(() => liveEvents.slice(0,5),[liveEvents]) + const items = history: ported; t = useNativeTranslation(); identical local names and memo deps.
L122-124 FadeIn delay={0.1} > GlassPanel p-6: ported (inline FadeIn delay 0.1s; styles.panel padding 24).

L125-151 header: the mb-4 flex items-center justify-between header -> styles.header (flexWrap+space-between, marginBottom 16). Left cluster (Activity icon + text-lg semibold title) -> <Glyph 'AC'/> + styles.title (fontSize 18 = text-lg, semibold). The connectionState==='connected' Wifi+'Live' (green-400) -> a green dot + green caption 'Live'; the 'reconnecting' WifiOff+'Reconnecting' (amber-400 animate-pulse) -> a <Pulse> amber dot + amber caption 'Reconnecting'; else null — same three-way branch. Right cluster shown only when historyStats && historyStats.total_executions > 0 -> styles.statsRow: `${total_executions} total`, green `${fmtPercent(success_rate,0)} success`, and `${formatDurationMs(avg_duration_ms)} avg`. Every key+English default preserved (totalRuns/successRate/avgDuration).
L153-160 live events block: rendered only when recentLive.length > 0 -> styles.liveList (mb-3 space-y-1 -> marginBottom 12, gap 4) mapping recentLive to <LiveEventRow key={evt.id} event={evt} />.

L162-180 history items block: isLoading -> styles.historyLoading (space-y-2 -> gap 8) of 5 skeleton bars keyed `skel-${i}` (Array.from({length:5})); else items.length > 0 -> styles.historyList (space-y-0.5 -> gap 2) mapping items to <HistoryRow key={item.id} item={item} />; else the EmptyState with the verbatim 'no-action: transient empty state…' comment, the Activity icon, and message t('automations.noHistory','No execution history yet').
L181-184 GlassPanel/FadeIn/return/function close: ported.

Native-safe browser-only behaviour (contract rules 4,5,7): (a) framer-motion FadeIn + Tailwind animate-pulse have no DOM analogue on native -> Animated.timing/Animated.loop with stop()-on-unmount cleanup; reduced-motion preference is not observable on bare RN so the decorative entry fade/pulse always play and never gate content. (b) lucide-react SVG icons are DOM-only -> text glyphs + the shared SemanticIcon chip + colour dots, preserving each status's distinct colour/meaning. (c) toLocaleString options degrade gracefully on Hermes (string still produced); this matches the already-shipped PeriodComparePage fmtNumber port.

Gates run from apps/native, all green: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) exit 0; `npm run lint -- --quiet` (eslint . --quiet) exit 0; `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` all suites/tests passed. The new file is self-contained and imported by no existing test, so the suite is unaffected.

No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported — only react, react-native primitives (Animated/StyleSheet/View), the ported web-parity api types, and the existing apps/native SemanticIcon / AppText / GlassPanel / theme tokens.
